title: TrueNAS Replication Failure Count
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=truenas:pool event=replication
| stats count(eval(status!="success")) as failed_replications by task
| where failed_replications>0
| sort - failed_replications
description: Uses TrueNAS replication events telemetry to monitor which replication tasks are failing most often in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for storage replication paths that need attention, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest TrueNAS replication events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps which replication tasks are failing most often so you can spot storage replication paths that need attention before it becomes annoying.
